name: @atlasauth/pca-oauth
description: OAuth 2.1 / MCP-authorization interop bridge for Proof-Carrying Authority: make a PCA resource server discoverable (RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata), challengeable (MCP 401 + WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata), and bindable (RFC 8707 resource indicators) over the agent-to-tool wire. PCA stays the proof layer; this is the discovery/challenge envelope.
